svg.title: RSS after the work stops: short-lived threads, 96-512 KiB, 8 workers; every thread joined at 0 s, then idle; RSS in MiB, median of n=40
svg.desc: Resident memory of each allocator's process at fixed times after its worker threads were joined, one median line per allocator on a shared zero-based axis from 0 to 250 MiB, and a table of when each one's memory settled. A dashed live data (theoretical minimum) line is the least RSS any allocator could return to: nothing is live after the drain, so it is the process's own RSS before any worker started.
svg.text: short-lived threads, 96-512 KiB, 8 workers; every thread joined at 0 s, then idle; RSS in MiB, median of n=40
time since every worker thread was joined
released by = first sample within 1.0 MiB of the 3 s sample (perf-ab's definition), median of n=40; peak is the external smaps_rollup peak; spread in latest.json
